mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.50% within a single month signals imminent monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises > 0.50% in a month, S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong labor market conditions and robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 550,000 units (HOUST > 550.0) signal a robust housing market that drives consumer confidence and economic expansion, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST > 550.0, S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.0%) indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 98.0 (INDPRO < 98.0) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 98.0, S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative policy response to inflation, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 100.0, S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
